name: nea-studio
description: NÉA STUDIO — beauty salon management & online booking

scripts.setup: npm i && npm i --prefix server && npm i --prefix client && npm run db:up && npm run db:deploy --prefix server && npm run db:seed --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client -- --port 4200"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
